audio_analysis_modules.chroma_analysis.analyze_chroma_and_clusters(track_data)[source]

Analyzes chroma features, performs clustering on sections, assigns semantic labels based on cluster properties and rules, calculates section features, and applies cleanup.

Parameters:

track_data (dict) – Dictionary containing base analysis results including ‘y_processed’, ‘sr’, ‘bpm’, ‘hop_length’, ‘beat_frames’, ‘section_starts’, ‘original_section_labels’, ‘rms_times’, ‘rms’, ‘trim_offset_sec’, ‘duration_processed’, ‘seconds_per_bar’. May also contain ‘spec’, ‘freqs’, ‘times_absolute’.

Returns:

An updated dictionary containing ‘semantic_labels’, ‘label_colors’,

’section_features’ (list of dicts), ‘cluster_labels’, ‘root_indices’, ‘root_times_absolute’, ‘chroma_sync’, ‘labels_before_cleanup’. Returns default structure on failure.

Return type:

dict
